title: Zesty Pork Skewers
description: A flavorful and spicy twist on traditional pork skewers, inspired by Filipino cuisine. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.notes: Make sure to cut the pork into even sizes for even grilling.

ingredients.name: Zesty Filipino marinade (see below)
ingredients.notes: Adjust the level of spiciness to your liking.

ingredients.name: Bamboo skewers
ingredients.notes: Soak the skewers in water for at least 30 minutes before grilling.

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the zesty Filipino marinade ingredients.
Add the pork cubes to the marinade and mix until coated.
Thread the marinated pork onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill grates with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and slightly charred.
Transfer the skewers to a plate and garnish with chopped green onions, chili flakes, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Serve immediately with lime wedges on the side.
